description: As an observability engineer, you have updated a Grafana dashboard configuration and need to bump the project’s semantic version and update the changelog to reflect your changes. The project lives in /home/user/grafana-dashboard. Inside this directory, you will find a file named VERSION containing the current semantic version (e.g., 1.3.2). There is also a file named CHANGELOG.md detailing previous changes; it uses the following format for each entry: ## [NEW_VERSION] - YYYY-MM-DD - SHORT_DESCRIPTION [other entries…] Your tasks are: 1. Increment the PATCH version number in the VERSION file by 1, following semantic versioning rules. For example, if VERSION says 1.3.2, update it to 1.3.3. 2. Prepend a new entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md documenting your change. Use the following parameters: - [NEW_VERSION]: The updated version number. - YYYY-MM-DD: Today’s date. - SHORT_DESCRIPTION: “Tuned dashboard query for improved latency”. 3. The new changelog entry must exactly match this format with two hashes (##), square brackets for the version, dash for the date, and start each bullet point with a dash. After making these updates, display the first five lines of CHANGELOG.md and the contents of the VERSION file in the terminal.
